headline: Expanse Surges as Linn Quickens, Cape Grinds On
war_summary: Since the afternoon edition the Weathered Expanse has surged to the sharpest pace while Linn Mercy quickens and former hot spots pause. The Expanse counts seven changes in two hours and eighteen on the day around Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch and Necropolis, listing six Warden, one Colonial and two ruined posts amid 984 Colonial and 761 Warden casualties in two hours. Linn Mercy counts four in two hours and thirty-one on the day around Outwich Ranch, Rotdust and Lathair, listing three Warden, seven Colonial and one ruin amid 591 Colonial and 764 Warden casualties in two hours. Mooring County holds steady with five in two hours and thirty-one on the day around The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast, listing ten Warden and two Colonial posts. Callum's Cape still grinds with two in two hours but forty-four on the day around Naofa, Scouts Jest and Ire, holding four Warden and three Colonial posts amid the heaviest day losses at 11,585 Colonial and 9,598 Warden casualties. Marban Hollow and Stonecradle record none in the last two hours after earlier flurries at Checkpoint Bua and The Dais, while Nevish Line, Godcrofts and Callahan's Passage extend their quiet and Lykos Isle shows a minor two-change stir at The Squall.
